title: [Decision] C8 under a wall: four framework writes that have no organization to name — self-registration grant, identity mail, activity, deployment-level secrets
body:
Ruled: 6257510973 · letters Q1 A · Q2 A · Q3 A · Q4 A · 2026-10-19T01:09Z

Filing gate **②**: a decision only the maintainer can make. Reader who acts: the maintainer rules; the epic PM (`epic:#15194`, `session_01Y5583bs2RDd53MH6kM1ca3`) executes it as C8 stages before 8b (#15212). Dedupe: semantic search on objectstack-ai/objectstack, all states, "walled self-registration grant identity mail activity deployment-level secret organization D7 D9" → 6 hits (#15194, #15212, #24343, #24282, #23872, #17300); none asks these questions. Source: the stage 8b-0b measurement in the os-dev-report on #24343 (PR #24369).

Blocks: C8 stage 8b's walled half (lifting the system-insert exemption). It does not block anything under `single`, where PR #24369 already names the Default Organization for every one of these writes.

## 维护者速读

**一句话问题：** 带墙（单库多租户）的部署上，有四类数据在写入那一刻没有任何组织可归属：新用户自助注册时的权限授权、发给用户本人的验证/找回密码邮件、关于这些「无组织记录」的活动流、以及部署级的密钥和全局设置的审计历史。v18 要求「有组织列的行必须有主」，C8 的 8b 一上线，这些写入在带墙部署上就会被拒——注册流程会断。每一类该怎么处理？

**你要做的：** 四个子问题各选一个字母。推荐 **Q1 A · Q2 A · Q3 A · Q4 A**。

| 子问题 | 推荐 | 客户感受 | 工作量 |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| Q1 自助注册授权（`sys_user_permission_set`） | **A** 推迟到用户加入第一个组织时再授予 | 注册后先没有该权限集，加入组织那一刻自动获得 | ~0.3–0.6k 行（plugin-auth 一处 + 持久化） |
| Q2 发给用户本人的邮件（`sys_email`） | **A** 身份类邮件不属于任何租户，不再记为租户数据 | 无感；邮件照发，只是记录落在部署级 | ~0.5–1k 行，是 D7 的修订 |
| Q3 关于无组织记录的活动流（`sys_activity`） | **A** 只为有组织列的记录写活动流，其余由部署级审计账本记录 | 无感；租户本来就读不到这些行 | ~0.1–0.2k 行 |
| Q4 部署级密钥与全局设置审计（`sys_secret`、`sys_setting_audit`） | **A** `sys_secret` 去掉组织列（归属看引用它的那一行）；全局设置的审计历史移到部署级 | 无感 | ~0.8–1.5k 行，是 D7 的修订，需要仪式里的数据去向 |

## Measured (the os-dev-report on #24343, `examples/app-crm`, posture `isolated`)

- One sign-up writes `sys_user_permission_set` 1/1, `sys_email` 1/1 and `sys_activity` 12/12 with no organization. The registrant belongs to no organization when the three are written.
- Encrypted settings: all 17 built-in ones are scope `global`. One `mail.api_key` write gave `sys_secret` 1/1 without an organization, and `sys_setting_audit` held 6/6 global-rung rows without one.
- Under `single`, PR #24369 makes every one of these rows name the Default Organization (dogfood census, ablation-proven).

## Governing text

- ADR-0131 D9: "a write on a tenant-column object with no organization is **derived** under `single` (the Default Organization is the only one) and **refused** otherwise."
- ADR-0131 D3: assignments are organization rows. D7: an object whose writer attributes rows to an organization is tenant data and keeps the column; a deployment-level object has no organization column; D7 keeps `sys_email` tenant data (the record's "Not touched" list, #14970 family).
- The record's sentence 3: "A table with no organization column is deployment-level or code-level. It is protected by permissions, not by the tenant wall."

**Why it is not settled:** D9 says refuse, and refusing breaks walled sign-up (Q1, Q2) and loses audit activity on every sign-up (Q3). D7 classifies `sys_email`, `sys_secret` and `sys_setting_audit` as tenant tables by one producer each, while other producers of the same tables write deployment-level rows. Amending D7 is a record change.

**Protocol:** Q2 and Q4 under A change D7's table classification (an ADR-0131 amendment, Tier H) and drop or move organization columns (spec object declarations, reviewed at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`). Q1 and Q3 change runtime behaviour only.

## Premises (re-check on current `origin/main`)

1. `settleSelfRegistrationGrant` exists: `git grep -n "private async settleSelfRegistrationGrant" origin/main -- packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts` → 1 hit. Control: `git grep -c "class AuthManager" origin/main -- packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts` ≥ 1.
2. The system-insert exemption still lets these rows through: `git grep -c "PLATFORM_OBJECT_TENANCY" origin/main -- packages/objectql/src/tenancy/platform-object-tenancy.ts` ≥ 1 (stage 8b retires it).
3. Encrypted settings are global: `git grep -n "encrypted: true" origin/main -- packages/services/service-settings/src` (the 17 hits the report counts).

## Options per question (business meaning)

- **Q1.** A — like a staff card issued on the first day at a branch, not at the job interview. B — refuse under a wall; an organization admin assigns the set later. C — a deployment-level grant: rejected, D3 rules assignments are organization rows.
- **Q2.** A — a letter addressed to a person, not to a company, is filed in the building's mail room, not in a tenant's cabinet. B — derive the recipient's single membership where there is exactly one, A or C for the rest. C — refuse: the walled sign-up verification mail cannot be sent.
- **Q3.** A — the tenant's activity stream shows only things that belong to the tenant; the building's ledger (`sys_audit_log`, D7) still records the rest. B — the actor's organization (none at sign-up). C — let 8b refuse (a recurring audit error).
- **Q4.** A — a key belongs to whoever owns the lock it opens: the owning row (`sys_setting`, `sys_platform_setting`, the datasource) carries the organization where there is one. B — keep them tenant tables and declare them platform-global per deployment on control planes. C — split each object by rung or producer.

## Recommendation: Q1 **A** · Q2 **A** · Q3 **A** · Q4 **A**; fallbacks Q1 B · Q2 B · Q3 C · Q4 B

- **项目长远合理性（定调）：** 四个推荐都落在记录的第三句上——没有组织列的表就是部署级的，靠权限保护，不靠租户墙。两年后的平台：一行数据要么属于一个组织（列非空），要么在部署级表里（没有这一列），不存在「有列但空着」的第三种。主流多租户平台（Salesforce 的 org 内对象与平台对象之分、Stripe 的 account 与 platform 资源之分）同样把「身份/平台」和「租户」分在不同的表里。B、C 这类选项要么靠例外名单维持，要么把断路留给运行时。
- **实际业务需求：** 今天撞上的是带墙部署的注册流程（cloud 控制面每次注册都会写出这四类行，#24343 的普查）。cloud 冻结在 v17，C10 迁移时会遇到。`single` 部署不受影响（PR #24369 已处理）。Q1 有一个本会话测不到的前提：cloud 控制面在用户还没有组织时，是否需要 `cloud_control_plane_member` 这个权限集才能创建第一个组织——如果需要，A 会断掉这条路，只能选 B；需要 cloud 席实测。
- **防 AI 写代码犯错：** A 方案每条都是一个结构性规则（「身份类邮件不是租户数据」「活动流只记有组织列的记录」「密钥的归属看引用它的行」），而不是一份逐个模板、逐个对象的例外清单——例外清单正是 AI 最容易漏写、写错的地方。C 方案是响亮拒绝，但拒的是正常业务（注册）。
- **创业阶段不扩散：** Q3 A 最省；Q1 A 要一个持久化的「待授予」记录；Q2 A、Q4 A 是 D7 修订加数据去向，工作量最大，但都是减少（去掉列、减少租户表），不新增能力，也不新增门禁。

自检：只看①选 A·A·A·A；②③④ 是否翻转：否——② 只决定时序（cloud 迁移前必须定），④ 让 Q3 最先做，不改字母。Q1 的字母以 cloud 席的实测为前提（见上），实测证伪即改 B，这一条在裁后执行里写明。

**置信缺口：** cloud 控制面的真实注册流程与 `cloud_control_plane_member` 的用途，本会话的仓库范围里读不到。

## After the ruling

- The epic seat cuts each ruled answer into a C8 stage before 8b (8b-0c …), each under 3,000 lines, measured first. Q2 A and Q4 A carry an ADR-0131 D7 amendment (Tier H: your approval on the PR) and the ownership ceremony's fate for the moved rows.
- Q1 A is dispatched only after the cloud seat measures what `cloud_control_plane_member` gates before the first organization exists; if that measurement shows the set is needed to create the first organization, Q1 executes as B and the seat records the switch on this card.
- 8b then lifts the exemption in every posture; 8c and 8e follow the plan 6251466182.

os-decision-facets
- ① 项目长远合理性：A·A·A·A 缩小特例——每类数据要么有主、要么在部署级表里，不留「有列但空」；B/C 类选项留下例外名单或运行时断路。
- ② 实际业务拉动：带墙部署（cloud 控制面）每次注册都会撞上，C10 迁移前必须定；`single` 部署今天零拉动（已由 PR #24369 处理）。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错：A 都是一条结构性规则，不是逐模板/逐对象的例外清单；C 是响亮拒绝，但拒的是正常注册。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散：A 方案都是减法（去列、减少租户表、不加门禁）；Q2、Q4 工作量最大且需要 D7 修订。

Prior rulings read: "sys_email" "sys_secret" "sys_setting_audit" "self-registration" "D7" on #15194, #15212, #24343, #15207 threads → 2 hits (#15194 body: "D7 keeps `sys_http_delivery` and `sys_email` tenant data"; #24343 body's D7/D3 contract lines); ADR-0131 D3, D7, D9; thread: none.

Related: #24343 (PR #24369, stage 8b-0b), #15212 (C8 plan 6251466182), #15207 (C6, closed), objectstack-ai/cloud#1979 (C10).
